question: What ongoing practice sustains participation in the yogini assembly?
premises: Ritual drinking of that substance is enjoined.
The practice is to be done at all times.
The yogini assembly is the associated context or result.
inference: One should always partake of that substance so that the yogini assembly may occur.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' depends on prior verses.
plain_english: One should always drink that at the proper time, so that there may be an assembly of yoginis.
